passages.hail: Hail is a type of precipitation consisting of solid ice spheres, called hailstones, that fall from thunderstorm clouds. They fo__ when str___ updraft wi___ carry wa___ droplets hi__ into extr_____ cold reg____ of clo___. Hailstones fre___ and gr__ in size as they collide with and collect supercooled water until they become too heavy for the updrafts to support. They can vary in size, ranging from small pea-sized pellets to stones as large as golf balls or even larger, posing a major threat to crops and property.

questions.prompt: Question 21: complete fo__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：rm → form。They formは「それらは形成される」。Theyは前文のhailstonesを指します。

questions.prompt: Question 22: complete str___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ong → strong。strong updraft windsは「強い上昇気流」。水滴を持ち上げる風の強さです。

questions.prompt: Question 23: complete wi___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：nds → winds。windsは「風」。carryの主語となる複数名詞です。

questions.prompt: Question 24: complete wa___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ter → water。water dropletsは「水滴」。上昇気流が雲の高い部分へ運ぶものです。

questions.prompt: Question 25: complete hi__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：gh → high。high into ...は「〜の高い所へ」。運ばれる位置を表します。

questions.prompt: Question 26: complete extr_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：emely → extremely。extremely coldは「非常に冷たい」。形容詞coldを強める副詞です。

questions.prompt: Question 27: complete reg____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ions → regions。cold regions of cloudsは「雲の冷たい領域」。水滴が凍る場所です。

questions.prompt: Question 28: complete clo___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：uds → clouds。cloudsは「雲」。前文のthunderstorm cloudsに対応します。

questions.prompt: Question 29: complete fre___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：eze → freeze。freezeは「凍る」。過冷却の水を取り込み、氷となる過程です。

questions.prompt: Question 30: complete gr__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ow → grow。grow in sizeは「大きくなる」。重くなり、気流で支えきれなくなるという後文につながります。
